name: "Tidal Wave" Tiki Torch - 1.2G
description:
Exotic flower, blended with THCA diamonds, finished in fresh kief. 

Catch the rush and ride the current; Tidal Wave is a tropical hybrid that sweeps you up in sun-soaked bliss. With aromas of ripe pineapple, coconut cream, and a splash of citrus, this strain feels like a beach getaway in every hit. Its balanced hybrid effects roll in smooth: a wave of uplifting euphoria and creative energy that mellows into a lazy-lagoon body buzz.
Perfect for daydreaming under palm trees, chasing sunsets, or just bringing some island vibes to your couch.
